facts.about: Incorporated in 2008, Kaynes Technology is a leading end-to-end and IoT solutions-enabled integrated electronics manufacturing company. The company provides conceptual design, process engineering, integrated manufacturing, and life-cycle support for major players in the automotive, industrial, aerospace and defense, outer-space, nuclear, medical, railways, Internet of Things ("IoT"), Information Technology ("IT") and other segments.

flags.text: Operating leverage: profit +56%/yr vs sales +48%/yr over 3 years
Operating cash flow was negative over 5 years (₹-615 cr) despite ₹977 cr of profit
Receivable days stretched from 74 to 154 in 3 years

business.summary: Kaynes Technology is an integrated ESDM enterprise providing design, manufacturing, and lifecycle support for complex electronic systems. It serves sectors like automotive, aerospace, and defense, generating revenue through product sales and engineering services.

segments.name: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)
segments.note: The company operates predominantly in this single business segment.

guidance.statement: We are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth.
guidance.quote: So we don't want to commit on the top-line number, but whatever the market growth is there, because of the strategic initiatives of keeping the inventory, keeping the manufacturing flexible, and having a very committed people, we are quite confident of achieving the twice the market growth.

guidance.statement: We will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB.
guidance.quote: We said we will be funding for this capex for this year is about INR300 crores for OSAT, INR300 crores for PCB, and about INR250 crores for EMS business.

guidance.statement: We have committed a full year revenue of totally INR450 to INR500 crores between both.
guidance.quote: As far as OSAT and PCB is concerned, we already told from third quarter the revenue starts in both the business, and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.

guidance.statement: By end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive.
guidance.quote: which gives us the confidence that whatever the commitment that we have given to you as a leadership team, that by end of the financial year we'll turn the cash positive, we are pretty confident on that.

guidance.statement: We will outgrow the market and we will be doubling the market growth.
guidance.quote: That is one of the reasons that why we chose to say this time that we'll be outgrowing the market and we'll be doubling the market growth, so that our penetration is much more.

guidance.statement: We will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

guidance.statement: We will do OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.

guidance.statement: We are still sticking on to that $1 billion guidance for fiscal '28.
guidance.quote: See, on the growth, what we have projected $1 billion, we are still sticking on to that because for us, from our bare board, from our OSAT, additional buildings are going to take place.

guidance.statement: You can expect about 85 days and better net working capital.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect about 85 days and better net working capital.

guidance.statement: At the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.
guidance.quote: So, at the minimum, you can expect INR1,500 crores from our OSAT business.

guidance.statement: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.
guidance.quote: Similarly, you can expect about INR1,000 crores from PC Board business.

guidance.statement: At consol level, you'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.
guidance.quote: And going forward, at consol level, we'll definitely be OCF positive by end of this year.

guidance.statement: The company expects to maintain strong growth rates in EMS verticals to compensate for smart meter business reduction.
guidance.quote: So going forward, the reliance on this particular thing will certainly come down. And then, of course, it's getting replaced by equally good and worthy businesses.

scorecard.promised: Achieve twice the market growth rate to increase penetration.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 40.6% in Jun 2026, slowing from 69.7% in Jun 2024.
scorecard.evidence: Annual growth slowed from 51% in FY25 to 33% in FY26, though still high in absolute terms.

scorecard.promised: Turn OCF positive by end of FY26 and cash positive by FY27.
scorecard.delivered: OCF was negative ₹600 cr for FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Despite ₹364 cr PAT, OCF worsened from negative ₹82 cr in FY25 to negative ₹600 cr in FY26.

scorecard.promised: Expect about 85 days and better net working capital by March 2026.
scorecard.delivered: Cash conversion cycle reached 193 days by March 2026.
scorecard.evidence: Debtor days alone stand at 154, nearly double the total working capital target promised.

scorecard.promised: Targeting ₹450 to ₹500 crores combined revenue for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Pending; Jun 2026 revenue of ₹946 cr is currently driven by core EMS.
scorecard.evidence: Requires significant ramp-up from Q3 FY27 to meet the ₹500 cr target from a standing start.

scorecard.promised: Sticking to $1 billion revenue guidance for fiscal 2028.
scorecard.evidence: Requires a 32% CAGR over the next two years to reach the $1bn mark.

narrative.scoreline: Management continues to deliver robust top-line growth but has severely missed critical working capital and cash flow targets.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Strategic inventory build-up was a conscious decision to mitigate global supply chain volatility.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Inventory levels rose by ₹150 cr, contributing to a 193-day cash conversion cycle.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: The company is prioritizing collections by de-growing the smart metering business.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Receivable days have stretched from 74 to 154 days over the last three years.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Operating margins will normalize after temporary supply chain pressures.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Operating margins have remained stable at 15-16% despite reported macro cost pressures.

bull: Strong operating leverage with net profit growing 56% annually against 48% sales growth over three years.
Successful margin expansion from 10% in FY19 to 16% in FY26 demonstrates improved product mix.
Order book provides high visibility, representing approximately 1.5 years of forward revenue.
bear: Chronic inability to generate cash, with cumulative five-year OCF at negative ₹615 cr despite consistent profits.
Severe working capital deterioration with debtor days reaching 154, suggesting poor collection efficiency or aggressive terms.
High customer concentration risk with a single client accounting for nearly 24% of total revenue.
watch: Q3 FY27 revenue contribution from new OSAT and PCB facilities.

claims.claim: We took a conscious decision to degrow in smart metering to prioritize collections and improve balance sheet shape.
claims.quote: we have taken a conscious decision of growing more in EMS business, which is our traditional and core business, and we have degrown in the smart metering business

claims.claim: Increased inventory levels were a strategic decision to mitigate global supply chain volatility and ensure business continuity.
claims.quote: Though our inventory levels in terms of the working capital has gone up by about INR150 crores, as I said, this is a strategic decision that we took in the month of February, looking at the global market situation and the volatility.

claims.claim: Profitability is expected to take a couple of quarters to normalize due to global supply chain and macro cost pressures.
claims.quote: We expect this could take a couple of quarters for profitability to normalize and return to the levels as we had earlier committed to.

claims.claim: Near-term revenue was impacted by geopolitical disruptions causing customer deferments and supply chain delays.
claims.quote: Near-term top line performance did not fully meet market expectations, primarily due to geopolitical disruption, especially the West Asia conflict, which led to last-minute customer deferment, supply chain delays and product timing shift.

claims.claim: The company expects to reverse the trend in metering business working capital within three quarters.
claims.quote: Rest assured, ladies and gentlemen, we'll be able to bring it back at least to a level of reduction. I think the inflection point has stopped and will come into the reduction.

claims.claim: The company is transitioning from a traditional EMS provider to a differentiated ESDM and product-driven enterprise.
claims.quote: One of our key strategic priorities in the next few years will be to accelerate the transition from a traditional EMS-led organization to a differentiated ESDM and product-driven enterprise.

claims.claim: The order book represents typically a 12-month rolling forward basis, it represents about 1.5 years' worth of orders.
claims.quote: Our order book represents typically a 12-month rolling forward basis, it represents about 1.5 years' worth of orders, which continues to be valid even now.

claims.claim: The phase of translation of strategy into near-term outcomes taking longer than anticipated is behind us.
claims.quote: We recognize that this has tested patience, particularly in an environment where expectations are understandingly high. What is important however, is that this phase is behind us.

claims.claim: We are moving away from AMISP business but will continue to do meter as a product.
claims.quote: We are only saying that we will be away from the AMISP business. But meter as a product, which we were doing it for the last 5, 6 years, we are continuing to do.

claims.claim: Management asserts there are no governance concerns, and the recent disclosure issues were typographical errors, not lapses of intent.
claims.quote: These were errors in reporting of disclosure in notes to accounts and not lapse of intent, governance or conduct.

claims.claim: The acquisition was a strategic bilateral deal at an attractive price because the erstwhile parent was exiting India.
claims.quote: Kaynes had always been a supplier partner since Iskraemeco's India entity, and hence Kaynes was able to strike a bilateral deal and negotiated the same at an attractive price.

claims.claim: Working capital intensity is typical for the EMS industry, and normalization measures are underway to improve the cycle.
claims.quote: Firstly, the working capital intensity is typical to the EMS industry and multiple initiatives are underway to improve it

claims.claim: Commercial production has technically started with sample shipments, and revenue scaling is expected from FY27 onwards.
claims.quote: So, the samples have been shipped out, so in some sense, technically, the commercial production has started.

risks.text: Revenue recognition involves management judgement regarding variable consideration and cut-off risks.
Contingent liabilities include income tax, indirect tax matters, bank guarantees, and corporate guarantees.
Customer A accounts for 23.99% of sale of goods revenue.
Financial reporting is significantly dependent on a customised ERP system.
